description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Saga of the Beastslayer — LEGENDARY SLAYERS (WP-S2): attacks made by friendly Blood Claws / Thunderwolf Cavalry / Wulfen units have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE]. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active (Thunderwolf Cavalry A engaged with the Deff Dread, a VEHICLE); the scenario enters the Fight phase (P1 active). Setup privileges: P1's detachments Saga of the Beastslayer + Champions of Fenris, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation. Both players end their pile-in; a real click selects the Thunderwolf Cavalry to fight; the attack dialog sends every attack at the Deff Dread (All to target + Confirm); the melee hit rolls carry [LETHAL HITS] (no Thunderwolf Cavalry weapon has it natively) — dice log lethal_hits_weapon, the fight dice panel and the Dice Log tab.
